description: The file 'odb.c' is a C source file implementing core functionalities for an object database, likely for a version control system like Git. It handles object storage, retrieval, alternates, and associated operations such as reading object info, registering submodules, and managing object sources.

classes.name: cached_object_entry
classes.description: A structure representing a cached object in the object database, including object ID and object data (type, buffer, size).

methods.description: Finds and returns a cached object in the database given its object ID.

methods.description: Creates a temporary file within the object database with a specified pattern.

methods.description: Restores the primary object database source to its previous state.

methods.description: Finds an object database source or terminates the program if not found.
